user.title: Add a grill
user.description: A grill holds your meat probes. After it is added, add each probe to it.

data_description.grill_sensors: Sensors that read the grill itself, such as an ambient or dome probe. Optional.

user.title: Add a probe
user.description: Choose the probe that goes in the meat. Only devices with a temperature sensor are listed.

data_description.device: Its temperature sensors are found on the device.
data_description.colors: The colored bands on the probe, in order. Choose several for a striped probe. The Grill Card shows the probe in these colors.

data.auto_on: Turn on when it starts reporting

data_description.reading: The sensor the cook follows. For a probe with several sensors, this is usually the lowest one, the core.
data_description.channels: The probe's sensors, in order from the tip. The Grill Card lists them in this order.
data_description.auto_on: Turn the probe on by itself when it starts reporting, such as when it comes off its charger. Leave this off for a probe that reports all the time.
